name: PARGY-LAD
summary: PARGY-LAD is a psychedelic substance belonging to the Lysergamides chemical class.

combinations.note: Uncertain or unpredictable interaction on PsychonautWiki.
Uncertain or unpredictable interaction on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: PARGY-LAD likely acts as a 5-HT2A partial agonist. The psychedelic effects are believed to come from PARGY-LAD's efficacy at the 5-HT2A receptors. However, the role of these interactions and how they result in the psychedelic experience continues to remain an object of scientific elucidation.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It has recently appeared on the market alongside research chemical psychedelic lysergamides such as AL-LAD, ETH-LAD and PRO-LAD as a legal, grey-market alternative to LSD, and commercially distributed through online research chemical vendors, and is considered to be one of the least popular and available in the series.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelic lysergamides can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences that may lead to risky behaviour.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。迷幻麥角醯胺類可能造成心跳加快、血壓上升、焦慮、意識混亂，以及可能導致危險行為的驚恐體驗。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。迷幻麦角酰胺类可能造成心跳加快、血压上升、焦虑、意识混乱，以及可能导致危险行为的惊恐体验。

fact.en: The pargy part of its name marks a propargyl group, a carbon chain with a triple bond, attached to the lysergamide skeleton of LSD.
fact.zh: 名稱中的「pargy」代表炔丙基，也就是含三鍵的碳鏈，它被接在 LSD 的麥角醯胺骨架上。
fact.zhHans: 名称中的「pargy」代表炔丙基，也就是含三键的碳链，它被接在 LSD 的麦角酰胺骨架上。
